scheme_name: Production Incentive / Back-Ended Subsidy for Horticulture Crops
description: Offers direct financial incentives to farmers growing fruit trees, vegetables, and perennial crops to cover input costs.
benefits: ₹12,250 for Mango, ₹5,830 for Guava, up to ₹18,750 for winter vegetables, and ₹7,500/ha for coconut per year.
eligibility: Landowners and tenant farmers in Puducherry, Karaikal, Mahe, and Yanam with Farmer ID Cards
application_mode: Offline via Uzhavar Udhaviyagam (Farmers' Help Centres) / Online via State Portal

scheme_name: Production Incentive for Paddy Cultivation (Traditional & Conventional)
description: Provides per-acre direct cash support to paddy farmers to cushion rising cultivation costs and promote native high-yielding seeds.
benefits: Direct benefit transfer (DBT) per hectare financial incentive credited directly into farmer's bank account.
eligibility: Paddy growers registered with the Department of Agriculture, UT Puducherry
application_mode: Online via Puducherry Agri Portal / Uzhavar Udhaviyagam

scheme_name: Subsidy Registration for Millet & Groundnut Cultivation
description: Promotes rainfed oilseeds and millet crops by subsidizing certified seed cost, pest protection, and micro-nutrients.
benefits: 50% seed cost subsidy and input kit grants for groundnut and millet crops.
eligibility: All practicing farmers in Puducherry UT

description: Provides financial support for purchasing tractors, power tillers, rotavators, and brush cutters.
benefits: 50% subsidy on farm implements (up to ₹1,000,000 max depending on machine category).
eligibility: Individual farmers, registered farmer groups, and agri-entrepreneurs in Puducherry
application_mode: Offline via Additional Director of Agriculture (Mechanization)

scheme_name: Drip and Sprinkler Micro-Irrigation Assistance Scheme
description: Encourages water-saving drip and sprinkler irrigation installations for sugarcane, coconut, and horticultural crops.
benefits: 75% to 100% subsidy on installation of micro-irrigation systems for small/marginal farmers.
eligibility: Farmers owning cultivated land with accessible water sources in Puducherry, Karaikal, or Yanam

scheme_name: Subsidy Registration for Fodder Crop Cultivation
description: Encourages farmers to dedicate land to green fodder development (Co-4, Napier grass) to support local dairy production.
benefits: Financial assistance per hectare for green fodder planting seed kits and field maintenance.
eligibility: Farmers owning cattle and cultivating fodder crops in UT Puducherry
application_mode: Online / Offline via Department of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare

scheme_name: Puducherry Soil Health & Organic Farming Incentive
description: Promotes green manuring, soil testing, and application of bio-fertilizers and neem-coated inputs.
benefits: Free soil testing cards + 50% subsidy on organic manure, bio-agents, and green manure seeds.
eligibility: All resident farmers in UT Puducherry

scheme_name: Roof-Top Vegetable Gardening Kit Subsidy Scheme
description: Distributes subsidized urban garden kits containing grow bags, seeds, coco-peat, and bio-pesticides for rooftop vegetable farming.
benefits: 75% subsidy on mini rooftop vegetable gardening kits.
eligibility: Urban and semi-urban households residing in Puducherry UT
application_mode: Offline via Botanical Garden / Agriculture Department Outlets

scheme_name: Precision Farming Scheme for High-Value Crops
description: Promotes high-tech polyhouses, shade-net houses, and precision farming for flowers and exotic vegetables.
benefits: 50% capital subsidy for erecting shade net structures and polyhouses.
eligibility: Progressive farmers and agri-entrepreneurs in Puducherry UT
application_mode: Offline via Deputy Director of Agriculture (Horticulture)

scheme_name: Puducherry Crop Insurance Price Stabilization Scheme
description: State share subsidy for crop insurance premiums and relief assistance during natural disasters like cyclones.
benefits: 100% premium subsidy for small/marginal farmers under PMFBY and direct relief grants.
eligibility: Farmers affected by natural disasters or enrolled under crop insurance in Puducherry
